name: Beauty & Sense Ladies Salon
address: 54 St - Al Mamzar - Deira - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
owner_description: Welcome to Beauty & Sense Ladies Salon, where beauty meets luxury in a serene and welcoming environment. Our salon offers an all-inclusive range of beauty services designed to make every woman feel special, pampered, and rejuvenated. From head to toe, our expert team of beauty professionals is dedicated to providing personalized treatments that suit your unique style and needs.

reviews.text: I would say some of their team members are good and professional in some areas especially Amal, but they are all worst in haircut, no one is expert. Secondly, you should focus on the treatment, for that customer is there, instead of offering 20 more treatments. Your focus should be on customer satisfaction instead of trying to getting more and more money from customer on the spot. If customer is satisfy she will come again otherwise, no one will come back.

reviews.author: Soja Baburaj
reviews.text:
Zero star rating tbh. Worst experience ever!!
I booked an appointment and still had to wait 40 minutes. They even ruined my pedicure, they didn't trim my nails properly, and they made them so thin that they couldn't even apply the gel polish.

The waxing experience was even worse. The staff rushed through it because they had another customer waiting, and in the process, they ended up ripping my skin. The wax was far too hot, and despite me warning her multiple times, she continued using it. Very poor at professionalism.

To make matters worse, I had a child waiting with me the entire time, so the unnecessary delay and poor service wasted both my time and caused a very unpleasant experience.

reviews.author: Abdul Basith
reviews.text:
Excellent service and amazing staff!

I had a keratin treatment done at this salon, and I’m truly very happy with the experience. From the moment I walked in, all the staff were very kind, friendly, and welcomed me warmly. The service was excellent, and I felt comfortable throughout my visit.

I would like to especially mention Amal. Before coming to the salon, I noticed that many people had mentioned her name in the reviews, so I was really hoping to meet her—and I’m so glad I did. She was amazing with me and handled the entire keratin procedure with great care, patience, and genuine effort. You can really see how dedicated and skilled she is at her work.

I’m from Al Ain, and I traveled here for this salon, and it was completely worth it. I had a really good time, and the results are beautiful. The other staff members were also very nice and supportive.

Highly recommended! I will definitely visit again.
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you so much, glad you had an amazing experience, please visit again ! 💕

reviews.text: This is the worst salon i have ever been. I went there for my keratine protein treatment and they used very very bad chemicals on my hair. Over heating was also done to my hair. Due to this, on third day of my treatment when i did my hair wash, all my hairs became brittle, dry, frizzy and started breaking. The hair smelled so nasty. The experience was unforgetable and unbearable. I had to cut my hair lots to remove the damage and instarted taking medication for the damage done to my hair growth. I also took my cash back from them. Very bad quality service. I do not recommend anybody to go here.
